policy.fixed_points: Exactly the32 existing V106 candidate vertex IDs and lexfirst4 pilot poses; no reselection/relocation.
policy.ray: Double-sided Moller-Trumbore, original triangle order; camera origin0, normalized camera ray. Reject abs(det)<=64*FP64eps*||edge1||*||edge2||; distance>0.
policy.barycentric_acceptance: Report three fixed sensitivity settings0,64*FP64eps(primary arithmetic tolerance),1e-10; no semantic visibility threshold or label chosen.
policy.tie: Distance tie tolerance=256*FP64eps*max(1,target_ray_range_mm,max_vertex_camera_range_mm). Preserve hit triangle IDs, expected-vertex incident membership, exact minimum ties and bounded ties.
policy.pixels: 3x3 offsets[-1,0,1] around floor(original projected r+.5), retain every OOB/zero-depth/overlap/unassigned sample. Source raw depth*depth_scale ->mm.
policy.owner: Complete scene_gt list, all corresponding mask_visib PNGs; own mask and own mask_visib separate. >0 source raster membership, no M0 gate.
policy.differences: Raw observed depth(mm)-fixed surface cameraZ and -target-alone first-hit cameraZ at that integer pixel ray; camera range distances separately preserved.
policy.interpretation: Numeric evidence only, no D/E/S training label or source admission. No-hit is not declared a hole; non-watertight topology and ray sensitivity stay explicit.
